title.narrative: Preparedness funds for MSB:s international operations

description.narrative: Förvaltningskostnader för beredskap, denna post täcker till exempel utbildning av insatspersonal, utveckling av materiel och logistikverktyg etc.

This post covers MSB´s indirect costs to secure that the agency is prepared to engage in international aid operations. The post covers for example training of field staff, development of solutions for equipment and logistics, internal functions at the agency etc
Det förväntade resultatet är att MSB har kapacitet att initiera, hantera och leda insatser
The expected results is to ensure capacity at HQ level at MSB to administer and manage projects to save lives, alleviate suffering and contribute to increased secruity and reconstruction.
